programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#65粵
programme.desc: 朋與悅雖然決裂，但仍很關心婷的學業，更在人前假扮恩愛。父母吵架令婷不願留家，言行亦變得粗俗，慶發覺婷與壞朋友來往。有朋誤會蕙婷遭人禁錮，迎接三位大漢的挑戰。夫妻竟然因此而和好，卻不知他們是「入錯房」。

programme.title: 尚食#5粵普
programme.desc: 姚子衿在宮中偶遇朱瞻基，讓她回想起兒時第一次見到他的情景，她甚至在送餐過去時悄悄觀察他的臥室。太子妃辦賞花會，郭側妃提議藉此進行典廚比賽。殷紫萍得知太子妃心儀豆腐，故以豆腐入饌，希望得到太子妃賞識。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺從芸芸花膠款式中，選用較細小的鴨泡膠代替雲吞皮製作「花膠雲吞」，留意他示範處理細薄花膠的方法。為何鼎爺選用五花腩製作餡料？釀入餡料後用韭菜紮起頭尾再蒸熟，精緻雲吞配香濃上湯或上湯蠔油芡，同樣美味！再看鼎爺怎樣處理豬脷，將豬脷切片配上醒胃的話梅蒸香，話梅的鹹香令菜式錦上添花。他接着利用雞蛋殼炮製「三色蛋」，先在雞蛋殼開小洞，然後加入蒸熟的皮蛋與鹹蛋粒，再倒進蛋白蒸熟。想成品美觀又嫩滑，有何秘技？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 肺結節雖大多屬良性，但仍有機會演變為肺癌。呼吸系統科醫生細述結合內窺鏡與導航技術的診斷新方法，並介紹新型的肺結節消融術，都有助減低病人接受治療時的痛楚與風險。鄧達智又帶大王、秀怡外出覓食，走進英式懷舊風格餐廳，先享用豐盛的英式全日早餐，再推介經典法式洋蔥湯、招牌炸雞與油封鴨腿。最後以火焰雪山甜品作結，冰火交融，儀式感滿滿。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐選用時令的香椿菜，帶來營養豐富的「蝦蓉香椿菜煎蛋」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 祖藍學到這集的關鍵潮汕話「雜雜落」，即甚麼款式都有之意，一於跟他食盡各式汕頭宵夜美食。珠江路美食街一間乾麵店，明明乾麵才是主角，「配角」一碗湯卻有齊豬肉、豬雜、海鮮、丸子？難怪獲攝製組選為冠軍美饌。鑽入民居區，有間夫妻檔餃子店，祖藍點了「雜雜落」的餃子，吃來竟似在開盲盒！他一直期待的芒光餃，卻留守至最後才讓他吃到，究竟芒光是何食材？吃雜錦水果解膩，祖藍奇怪是「鹹鹹的」，原來是甘草在作怪！

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#17粵PG
programme.desc: 司徒嵐懷孕，兆明勤奮打理家務。力奇、喜詩和菲兒有意結束咖啡店，司徒嵐反對。鄧勤知道曉盈使計令蔣生凍結他的冷壓果汁計劃，也揭穿曉盈用詭計令德正陷入困境。酒醉德正向丹丹傾訴心事，透露為了美娜將股份賣給百喜昇。曉盈代表百喜昇接手管理鼎福和，提出人事和生產線變動，更終止兆明的顧問合約。兆明鬱悶回到村口，司徒嵐走上車雀躍地道出小說結局，一輛貨櫃車突然失控撞來。二人送院搶救，司徒嵐昏迷不醒更發現腦內有瘀血……

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: TRIGGER在雨中進行街頭表演，有人駐足觀賞，亦有人不顧而去。聽見粉絲支持的聲音，天深受感動，忍不住當眾流淚。一織分析陸人氣急升的原因，發現關鍵在於其驚人的訴求力，並擔心有朝一日會不受控制。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 四位女生分別代表啫喱隊與布甸隊，到「零食廠」闖關，爭奪健康零食秘笈作為獎勵，究竟哪一隊可交出更佳表現？這回「廠長話」遊戲，蚌蚌公主將發號施令的重任交給「團長」Tiffany姐姐，她會設下甚麼難題，考驗小兵們的聆聽能力和反應？兩隊於「溶化之橋」關卡同樣發揮出色，成功運送逾二十個雪糕球，勝負僅在一球之差。壓軸挑戰「看圖砌漢堡」更是緊張刺激，雙方再次展示敏捷身手，完成時間都非常接近。

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 五十嵐在其他人面前隱藏實力，令蜻蛉大為不滿，更罵他是騙子，此事令五十嵐想起自己過往曾冷待兒子，導致對方放棄打高爾夫球。五十嵐把蜻蛉父親留下的握把換到挖起桿上，成功吸引她試用挖起桿。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 膀胱癌是泌尿系統其中一種常見的惡性腫瘤，吸煙是最主要的發病因素，63歲的黃先生吸煙多年，約兩年前的一日突然小便痛，伴隨血水，看醫生服了一星期紓緩藥都沒用，之後看第二位醫生確診膀胱癌，切除了4厘米的腫瘤後，再覆診時，醫生說要全切除膀胱再重建假膀胱，手術後黃先生休息了三個月便復工，不用服藥，現時每半年覆診一次。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 市民報料，稱啟德體育園附近有居屋單位被暫出租予演唱會觀眾存放行李，攝製隊前往疑似涉事單位了解情況。2021年，聾啞女士美華遭女保安逐出亡父遺下的公屋單位，事件引全城關注。其後美華入稟法院要求取回單位部分業權，案件近日宣判，美華勝訴。陸偉雄大狀分析美華贏官司的關鍵，並就其現況提出後續建議。眾演員齊集商場觀賞《正義女神》首集播映，送上活動花絮。繳付信用卡最低還款額，跟為結欠申請自主分期，二者有何差別？

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2775粵
programme.desc: 講真話隨時會惹麻煩！面對應否直言的情況，樹根經常騙他人代勞以解決問題。為了躲懶並避免惹禍，樹根設法讓瑞素代他向Bonnie提出修改對白極長的某場戲，怎料生出變故。樹根遂說謊騙力王代勞，力王因此得罪Bonnie。其後，家聰發現力王常被樹根利用代為發聲，淪為代罪羔羊，遂打算替力王出氣。後來，樹根一反常態，不能自控地直言實話，得罪人之外，更有洩露秘密的危機，不禁心慌……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#2粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知趕往現場，目睹宇澤的母親蘇麗慈持刀挾持成彬，事態逐漸失控……一年後，惠知放棄升職，主動調遷少年法庭，更因此與光正離婚。工作嚴謹的惠知，與輕鬆的裁判法院法官們格格不入。海濱公園內，滿身鮮血的姚振銘，向路經的裁判官鄭邵文稱砍傷了姊姊和妹妹。父親認定振銘是妒忌姊姊得到偏愛而犯案，辯方律師程睿燊以振銘有精神問題抗辯。感化官鄭邵玲認為振銘的姊弟關係其實不錯，惠知要求邵文上庭作證，讓振銘道出真相……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#19粵普PG
programme.desc: 楚楚在柳世江屍體旁發現毒蟲卵殼，檢查後確認毒蟲是在其體內生長。楚楚試探玉瀾，玉瀾反應激烈。瑾瑜將柳世江死因告知韓績，問他與玉瀾關係。陸續有百姓失蹤，瑾瑜推測與毒蟲之事有關，便引蛇出洞找出毒營所在。

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 遼寧大連的海鮮夠肥美，螻蛄蝦被指有陣似洗衣粉的土腥味？世韜師傅這次選用平民價的大連鮮鮑魚，並以青花椒油、泡椒、鹹酸菜做湯底，煮出香濃的「酸菜鮑魚」。主持區永權見鮑魚煮至五成熟即關火，曾感懷疑，吃後卻大讚這做法！四川青神縣是「椪柑之鄉」，用柑、椒等蔬果可炮製甚麼美食？錄影廠內，創意廚師譚詠儀師傅轉用青檸及其汁，製作蔥味冷盤「涼拌青檸豬手」！豬手用凍水汆水、浸煮一小時再浸冰水，偏多的工序有何實際功用？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#35粵
programme.desc: 少龍被封「護國上將軍」，往蕞城迎擊趙軍。善柔與廷芳喬裝夫妻，在渡頭要求歌舞團班主鳳姐的船載二人到齊國。團中台柱鳳菲一聲不響嫁人，鳳姐發現廷芳貌似鳳菲，決定由她假扮鳳菲表演。不韋以東郡民變要求派王翦先往平亂，再趕往蕞城，嬴政無奈答允。李牧相約少龍城樓外會面痛飲，從此恩斷義絕。少龍項正擔心王翦的援軍未到，一群墨者來相助守城，豈料卻倒戈相向。少嬴政知道蕞城失守，少龍生死未卜，猶如五雷轟頂。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 市民報料，稱啟德體育園附近有居屋單位被暫出租予演唱會觀眾存放行李，攝製隊前往疑似涉事單位了解情況。2021年，聾啞女士美華遭女保安逐出亡父遺下的公屋單位，事件引全城關注。其後美華入稟法院要求取回單位部分業權，案件近日宣判，美華勝訴。陸偉雄大狀分析美華贏官司的關鍵，並就其現況提出後續建議。眾演員齊集商場觀賞《正義女神》首集播映，送上活動花絮。繳付信用卡最低還款額，跟為結欠申請自主分期，二者有何差別？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 肺結節雖大多屬良性，但仍有機會演變為肺癌。呼吸系統科醫生細述結合內窺鏡與導航技術的診斷新方法，並介紹新型的肺結節消融術，都有助減低病人接受治療時的痛楚與風險。鄧達智又帶大王、秀怡外出覓食，走進英式懷舊風格餐廳，先享用豐盛的英式全日早餐，再推介經典法式洋蔥湯、招牌炸雞與油封鴨腿。最後以火焰雪山甜品作結，冰火交融，儀式感滿滿。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐選用時令的香椿菜，帶來營養豐富的「蝦蓉香椿菜煎蛋」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 祖藍學到這集的關鍵潮汕話「雜雜落」，即甚麼款式都有之意，一於跟他食盡各式汕頭宵夜美食。珠江路美食街一間乾麵店，明明乾麵才是主角，「配角」一碗湯卻有齊豬肉、豬雜、海鮮、丸子？難怪獲攝製組選為冠軍美饌。鑽入民居區，有間夫妻檔餃子店，祖藍點了「雜雜落」的餃子，吃來竟似在開盲盒！他一直期待的芒光餃，卻留守至最後才讓他吃到，究竟芒光是何食材？吃雜錦水果解膩，祖藍奇怪是「鹹鹹的」，原來是甘草在作怪！

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#17粵PG
programme.desc: 司徒嵐懷孕，兆明勤奮打理家務。力奇、喜詩和菲兒有意結束咖啡店，司徒嵐反對。鄧勤知道曉盈使計令蔣生凍結他的冷壓果汁計劃，也揭穿曉盈用詭計令德正陷入困境。酒醉德正向丹丹傾訴心事，透露為了美娜將股份賣給百喜昇。曉盈代表百喜昇接手管理鼎福和，提出人事和生產線變動，更終止兆明的顧問合約。兆明鬱悶回到村口，司徒嵐走上車雀躍地道出小說結局，一輛貨櫃車突然失控撞來。二人送院搶救，司徒嵐昏迷不醒更發現腦內有瘀血……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#65粵
programme.desc: 朋與悅雖然決裂，但仍很關心婷的學業，更在人前假扮恩愛。父母吵架令婷不願留家，言行亦變得粗俗，慶發覺婷與壞朋友來往。有朋誤會蕙婷遭人禁錮，迎接三位大漢的挑戰。夫妻竟然因此而和好，卻不知他們是「入錯房」。

programme.title: 尚食#5粵普
programme.desc: 姚子衿在宮中偶遇朱瞻基，讓她回想起兒時第一次見到他的情景，她甚至在送餐過去時悄悄觀察他的臥室。太子妃辦賞花會，郭側妃提議藉此進行典廚比賽。殷紫萍得知太子妃心儀豆腐，故以豆腐入饌，希望得到太子妃賞識。

programme.title: 我係小廚神粵
programme.desc: 今集9位小廚師將以三人團體形式轉戰農莊。三組先品嚐滋味農家菜，再加入獨特創意，炮製剛剛品嚐過的「三餸一湯」，今次最高分一組全隊可順利出線；較低分的兩組則由評判選出表現強差人意的兩位淘汰出局！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#66粵
programme.desc: 喜好友芳即將舉家回鄉，欲將生果店轉讓。喜舉行家庭會議，要求進軍生果店，惜眾人反對。喜無奈，決定私下購入生果店。喜私下到生果店實習，令藥房出現大混亂。眾家人見喜舉動異常，竟誤會她染上賭癮欠下巨債。

programme.title: 尚食#6粵普
programme.desc: 沒有獲升為典膳，紫萍大失所望。乾清宮走水，喻美人縱火被擒，莊妃受牽連被軟禁，子衿和紫萍偷偷為其送飯。喻氏供認太子指使自己下毒，眾人於聖前對質。子衿說出喻氏染疾一事，瞻基又發現關鍵證據，幫太子扭轉局勢。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 本地紅蔥頭味道香濃，用作配料或製作醬料同樣合適。鼎爺將海味、香料、醬料三大類材料放入攪拌器打蓉，再慢慢炒勻，「自家製沙茶醬」可謂零失敗！芥蘭取出蘭度，與嫩滑牛柳同炒，再加入沙茶醬調味，即成滋味菜式。火腩帶有油香，腓排亦具鮮味。「春菜排骨煲」的春菜吸盡兩種香味，更是精華所在。阿爺及後將蟹膏、蟹肉與肉餅拌勻，並一同蒸煮，帶來外觀、味道兼備的「膏蟹蒸肉餅」。將豬肉肉餅分別剁成蓉和碎粒，還有助提升口感。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 血壓測量到甚麼數字代表血壓高？心臟科醫生還提到，狀況有可能導致嚴重併發症！患者一般都要長期服藥，而降血壓藥分為五大類，需注意相關副作用。醫生亦提供有助預防高血壓的生活習慣建議。據指逾半數男性長者都有前列腺肥大問題，也擔憂會引致患癌，有甚麼相關檢查？前列腺肥大會壓住尿道致小便困難，如服藥療效欠理想，又有何新型手術可助病人解困？「睇餸食飯」，李家鋌師傅參考日式天婦羅的做法，炮製一道「金沙酒香杏鮑菇」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 汕頭之旅新一集，祖藍不止坐低等食，還提出要跟兩位頂流潮菜大師學藝，嘗試烹調幾道經典潮菜。大師給他的首要任務是買食材，「過海」、「帶靴」究竟是甚麼？展示「豆醬煮膏蟹」做法，不用刀徒手就可剝開蟹蓋，不愧為大師！還有「滷水乳鴿」、「鮮蝦釀吊瓜」，祖藍統統都學會了！入夜，祖藍走進火鍋店一試滷水火鍋，配鵝材同吃，夠濃味。不過，祖藍更推介店內的老菜脯粥底火鍋，也可配以鮮美的海鮮；但為何粥底內不見米飯？

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#18粵
programme.desc: 兆明日以繼夜照顧昏迷的司徒嵐，秀瓊看在眼內深受感動。曉盈買鑽石表獎勵自己坐上CEO位置，威龍提醒她無須爬到山頂。威龍帶麗娟探望秀瓊，秀瓊坦言要照顧女兒，同時不忘守護鼎福和。秀瓊看到兆明頹廢，曉以大義鼓勵他振作。百喜昇召開記招交代鼎福和未來發展，竇彰指收購的事仍未下定案。曉盈不滿威龍站在竇彰一方，威龍坦言在幫她。司徒嵐甦醒，卻完全失去對兆明的記憶，視他為陌路人；醫生指司徒嵐有可能永遠失去記憶……

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 一織釐清陸的特質後，明白到是其哀求人的表情產生的效果，於是決心要令陸感到幸福滿足。大和等人上門探望TRIGGER，龍之介勸壯五與家人和好，環卻表現激動，更要出手打人，天見狀叫他一起出去買食物。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 人口普查收集人口數據，原來香港有團體推行「麻雀普查」？「Kids’ Notes」請來團體代表述說相關普查細節。在港可見的麻雀主要有三種，包括樹麻雀、家麻雀、山麻雀，各有甚麼特色？嘉賓還談及麻雀如何用乾沙「洗澡」。另外，香港不時有野鴿聚集，但原來大多都不是本地原生，而是外來物種？珠頸斑鳩則是香港原生雀鳥，頸上的斑點就是其特徵！常說「麻鷹捉雞仔」，麻鷹也會在天空盤旋尋找食物，但牠們的主要食糧並非雞仔？

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 五十嵐誤信蜻蛉戲言，吃下山羊糞，成為島民笑柄。蜻蛉用高爾夫球桿打棒球，更把切刺身的方法應用到高球上，其控球技術再度令五十嵐驚訝。五十嵐發現蜻蛉缺乏鬥心，但他卻想讓對方參加比賽。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 油麻地有新盤交樓，窗邊防水膠條沒裝妥，地板也有罅隙及拱起，為何如此？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2776粵
programme.desc: Elaine偶然發現Venus向壯表白，壯則稱需要時間考慮再作答覆。Elaine與若水商議此事，被Ceci聽到，她建議Elaine寫情書表白。壯收到情書，終知悉Elaine的心意，滿心歡喜；原本一切順利，她卻因遺忘某事情而功虧一簣。Ceci再向她獻計，打算讓壯英雄救美，以製造表白機會。壯接到Elaine的訊息，得悉她有危險，竟未現身相救，也無回覆。Elaine懷疑壯正往見Venus，欲給她答覆……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#3粵PG
programme.desc: 邵文處理一宗家暴案，勾起自身回憶；童年的邵文與姊姊邵玲飽受母親毒打，邵玲為保護弟弟大義滅親。邵玲這次希望邵文的判決可令案中施暴父親付出代價，但事情其後出現變數……邵玲對邵文的判決感到不解，姊弟關係降至冰點。離島三少年在山頭活埋同學，此案由惠知接手審理。淑樺為其中一名被告辯護，提出三人只是受島上惡霸談卓飛唆擺作惡，犯案主謀應是卓飛。惠知、淑樺再次交鋒，二人都想起因麗慈母子而起的往事……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#20粵普PG
programme.desc: 玉瀾叫楚楚不要浪費時間，楚楚那邊的人到不了，但是他們的奇兵要到了。瑾璃帶人過來，路上遇到毒蟲，幸好楚楚早就研製出能驅散毒蟲的藥粉。祐辰安三人跑進廟裡，楚楚等人驅散毒蟲後再進去時，他們已經從地道跑了。

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 「90後女廚師」鄭紫欣擅長煮西餐，看過西安人製作當地的特色油潑麵後靈感迸發，加入西式食材，做出「西班牙辣肉腸蒜蝦肉燥麵」。紫欣顯技即席拉麵條，還應要求邊拉麵邊轉身，猶如某餐廳的師傅親臨表演，功架十足。蹺腳牛肉是四川樂山市在地美食，啟發家鋌師傅帶來「沸藤清湯牛腩」。粵菜中用蘿蔔、香料等燜煮的清湯腩，食用前淋上加熱的花椒油，能提升香氣層次。烹調過程中，祖儀這廚壇新手又發出甚麼妙語，讓師傅無言以對？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#36粵
programme.desc: 少龍偷入魏營救秦兵，暴露了身分，幸得龍陽君相救。此時信陵君率眾來搜，還取出魏王的御賜金牌……廷芳與善柔在渡頭救起漂浮江中的人，認出是少龍。廷芳自稱鳳菲，不肯跟少龍相認。不韋取笑嬴政將多出一個便宜弟郎，嬴政怒氣沖沖到大鄭宮，太醫指出朱姬有了身孕。嬴政要嫪毐護送不韋往巡視長城，伺機殺他。嬴政強行灌朱姬飲墮胎湯藥時，趙高突然來報指嫪毐事敗，嬴政為怕觸怒不韋，任由他處置嫪毐。嫪毐強忍劇痛，吃力爬上高樓。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.desc: 血壓測量到甚麼數字代表血壓高？心臟科醫生還提到，狀況有可能導致嚴重併發症！患者一般都要長期服藥，而降血壓藥分為五大類，需注意相關副作用。醫生亦提供有助預防高血壓的生活習慣建議。據指逾半數男性長者都有前列腺肥大問題，也擔憂會引致患癌，有甚麼相關檢查？前列腺肥大會壓住尿道致小便困難，如服藥療效欠理想，又有何新型手術可助病人解困？「睇餸食飯」，李家鋌師傅參考日式天婦羅的做法，炮製一道「金沙酒香杏鮑菇」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 汕頭之旅新一集，祖藍不止坐低等食，還提出要跟兩位頂流潮菜大師學藝，嘗試烹調幾道經典潮菜。大師給他的首要任務是買食材，「過海」、「帶靴」究竟是甚麼？展示「豆醬煮膏蟹」做法，不用刀徒手就可剝開蟹蓋，不愧為大師！還有「滷水乳鴿」、「鮮蝦釀吊瓜」，祖藍統統都學會了！入夜，祖藍走進火鍋店一試滷水火鍋，配鵝材同吃，夠濃味。不過，祖藍更推介店內的老菜脯粥底火鍋，也可配以鮮美的海鮮；但為何粥底內不見米飯？

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#18粵
programme.desc: 兆明日以繼夜照顧昏迷的司徒嵐，秀瓊看在眼內深受感動。曉盈買鑽石表獎勵自己坐上CEO位置，威龍提醒她無須爬到山頂。威龍帶麗娟探望秀瓊，秀瓊坦言要照顧女兒，同時不忘守護鼎福和。秀瓊看到兆明頹廢，曉以大義鼓勵他振作。百喜昇召開記招交代鼎福和未來發展，竇彰指收購的事仍未下定案。曉盈不滿威龍站在竇彰一方，威龍坦言在幫她。司徒嵐甦醒，卻完全失去對兆明的記憶，視他為陌路人；醫生指司徒嵐有可能永遠失去記憶……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#66粵
programme.desc: 喜好友芳即將舉家回鄉，欲將生果店轉讓。喜舉行家庭會議，要求進軍生果店，惜眾人反對。喜無奈，決定私下購入生果店。喜私下到生果店實習，令藥房出現大混亂。眾家人見喜舉動異常，竟誤會她染上賭癮欠下巨債。

programme.title: 尚食#6粵普
programme.desc: 沒有獲升為典膳，紫萍大失所望。乾清宮走水，喻美人縱火被擒，莊妃受牽連被軟禁，子衿和紫萍偷偷為其送飯。喻氏供認太子指使自己下毒，眾人於聖前對質。子衿說出喻氏染疾一事，瞻基又發現關鍵證據，幫太子扭轉局勢。

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: 蔣志光與韋綺姍再度合唱<相逢何必曾相識，人氣不減當年！湯寶如夥拍後輩關楚耀合唱一曲，還與蔣志光合唱其首本名曲<相思風雨中。彭健新、林欣彤、馮允謙、文佩玲、胡渭康亦以不同方式配搭，演唱經典合唱歌曲。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#67粵
programme.desc: 溢看戲時與妄顧公德的惡霸爭論，反被惡霸以歪理迫她道歉。但此事卻被拍成短片放於網上，溢訴苦，朋教溢向慶學「人善人欺天不欺」。溢到遊戲中心找尋慶，但溢竟又再遇上惡人，這次慶替他挺身而出，最終成功趕走惡霸。

programme.title: 尚食#7粵普
programme.desc: 漢王看到游一帆拜祭亡母，認出他是失蹤多年之子。胡善圍扭傷腳，唯有子衿願去送飯，令其對子衿頗為欣賞，願加以提攜。王遙清收月華為徒，兩人一起完善失傳古譜。紫萍在寒風中跪地一夜，終令孟尚食答應讓她再入庖廚。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 主持們登上小艇，享用「避風塘」招牌炒肉蟹、炒蜆美食，鼎爺還提起避風塘上的第一次約會。鼎爺購入一隻大龍蝦，起殼後要阿譚將龍蝦殼及蝦殼一起熬煮，做出濃蝦湯來炒伊麵。備用的龍蝦肉則連同荷蘭豆、百合、白玉木耳等配菜一起爆炒，鑊氣十足！二人另到果園摘香蕉，暢談香蕉適宜食用的時機。返回廚房，沒有蕉葉，轉用荷葉鋪上蒸籠，巧製一道「荷葉粉蒸肉」。阿譚想採用糯米粉替代炒勻糯米及粘米，卻未為拍檔接受，有何原因？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 祖藍漫步汕頭的商業區，與香港的中環氣氛大不同，同時亦蘊藏了一些當地特色美食。有雪糕店旨在創出新穎口味，以鴨屎香呈現汕頭獨有的雪糕味道之餘，另一款加入苦瓜的雪糕更是得獎之作！祖藍常讚汕頭牛好味，用新鮮牛肉造成漢堡扒，再以鹹菜代替酸瓜，製作出汕頭特色漢堡，既前衛又不覺味道奇怪；還有一款魷魚漢堡？汕頭有餐廳熬製雞煲湯底時分別加入百香果、木薑子，零舍開胃！店主更推介一款「糯米烤雞」，最不能錯過的是雞皮？

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#19粵PG
programme.desc: 司徒邦送司徒嵐玉珮，表示愛她的人永遠守護她。曉盈帶助手到鼎福和上班，一班員工有意刁難，但曉盈有備而來。秀瓊分別送紅酒和下酒食物給竇彰與德正，盼兩父子和好。兆明得知曉盈被中介商瞞騙，購入過期黃豆。曉盈抱怨威龍千方百計阻止她收購鼎福和，威龍反拿出鑽石戒指求婚……司徒嵐埋首會計工作，兆明傳短訊逗她開心。司徒嵐被兆明的經歷感動，但對他仍然沒有感覺，決定離開他。秀瓊對司徒嵐不再寫小說、結束咖啡店深感不安……

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 壯五拿著資料去遊說環讓他回家，環最終放行。ZOOL上去《Next Re:vale》做嘉賓，前半段一言不發，虎於企圖用筆嚇千卻被百反制，四人屈服配合節目進行，事後百把電話號碼交給對方。壯五回到家裡，與父親對峙。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」再次展開，Ban Sir率先帶領大家進行基礎體適能訓練。他指出，這些動作能有效提升協調、反應與速度，不僅有助日常運動表現，對做家務、行樓梯亦大有裨益。此外，小朋友亦可透過踢腿、交叉步等動作，增強平衡力與下肢肌肉。節目還會播出AI生成動畫《星星的銀幣》的下半部份，大家也要學習故事內小女孩的無私愛心，向身邊人傳遞溫暖和關懷。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 同學七海拾到一個星光兔的袋子，走來詢問陽葵是否她的，就在這時，另一位同學鈴夢則說這個袋子是她妹妹的，還強調自己身為模特兒對星光兔沒興趣。儘管如此，陽葵還是想和鈴夢交朋友，二人更開始熟絡起來……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 糖尿病是常見的都市病，在西方國家很普通，越來越多香港人亦患上此病，部分人甚至不知道已患上糖尿病，其實糖尿病就是人體的胰臟，不能分泌足夠的胰島素，或者胰島素失去應有的功能，新聞掏寶和大家重溫1991年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2777粵
programme.desc: 敢威、尚善與力蓮碰巧同時休假，無法聯絡得上。某項目臨時改為公開招標，作為最高決策人的璟風遂召集相關人員商議可要調整標價，卻未有定論，幸有人想到拖延之策。為免再出現高層真空狀況，璟風建議預早請假並互通消息，獲敢威同意。敢威打算兩星期後乘郵輪度假，怎料力蓮、尚善已申請休假，還似乎勢在必行，他只好取消行程，家聰卻提出另類解決方案。敢威對主管及以上級別推行新請假政策，意圖阻止力蓮休假，卻引發不少問題……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#4粵PG
programme.desc: 「離島三害案」尋回的兇器上，證實還有卓飛的DNA。惠知打算調查「第四名疑犯」卓飛的去向，並要求邵玲幫忙，終發現驚人內情。回到庭上，在惠知與檢控官林雅晴的追問下，最終揭出案件的殘酷真相！惠知藉判詞指出家長盲目包庇，令犯罪少年一錯再錯，淑樺聽出其用意，心情鬱悶。光正之女邱天雪，希望促成父親與惠知和好，卻事與願違。淑樺接到保鏢通知，指成彬不知去向，令淑樺大為緊張……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#21粵普PG
programme.desc: 高冷安郡王蕭瑾瑜和禦賜女仵作楚楚的婚後故事！事業、感情、格局全部升級，攜手三法司少年團，去偽求真查奇案，同心協力禦守大唐太平。

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 在四川，臘肉會加甚麼香料醃製？當地人還會故意把臘肉燒到變焦，再刮走表面燒焦一層，所為何事？世韜師傅概述四川臘肉與廣式臘肉之別，隨後用不同臘肉、臘腸炮製「四川臘味煲仔飯」；臘味頭頭尾尾亦不浪費，連同冰糖、生抽、老抽來煮出煲仔飯豉油，絕對夠美味！遼寧本溪有過百間賣烤豆皮的店舖，食材廉價簡單，濃味好吃的背後卻是工序多多！人氣女主廚紫欣教觀眾在家輕鬆「複製」，奉上「煙燻烤豆皮」，但對祖儀來說似乎不易……

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#37粵
programme.desc: 嫪毐以嬴政身世秘密要脅他確保一家三口安全。廷芳心緒不寧，排舞錯漏百出，少龍教她跳西班牙舞，二人關係轉好。廷芳在齊王面前表演後，突然有殺手跳出刺殺齊王，劍劃過廷芳的背。廷芳自知中毒垂危，向少龍剖白愛意，少龍承諾待她復元後娶她。少龍推測齊相田單籌劃刺殺行動，與善柔夜探田府，揭穿主公是齊墨鉅子曹秋道，秋道以善柔性命及解藥交換鉅子令秘笈。嫪毐與嬴政探望朱姬，嬴政的態度和善，原來嫪毐找來假嬴政密謀頂包秦王。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 壓軸一玩，在婚宴場地玩一番，由「垃圾之最」連詩雅、朱智賢鬥倒霉抽隊員，兩人的行為總是令人摸不著頭腦。大玩隊與特玩隊進行一對一單挑，蝦頭與楊潮凱造就「同姓一吻」；陳嘉桓、林秀怡竟出動肥肉搶鏡；翟威廉與朱智賢大鬥反應，威廉勝出卻輸風度！「開口中」遊戲談起情侶間的暱稱，眾人戀情被Bob擺上檯，為何最後區永權要接受吃辣飯的懲罰？藝員搶花球爭獎品，有甚麼東西令蝦頭感動流涕？慰勞宴上，眾人分享最難忘的事。

programme.title: 萌馬吼吼S1
programme.desc: 主人公吼吼，是一隻可愛的奶油獨角獸，他生活在甜蜜鎮上，這裡的居民都是各種甜品，有著各自的職業。作為一名快樂的打工人，吼吼每天都在小鎮的不同地方打工，當髮型師助理時，用自己的奶油為甜品們打造時下最流行的髮型，尤其是杯子蛋糕，對他的設計總是讚不絕口；吼吼還做過神奇的天氣安排員，尤其是想要吃糖的日子，更是少不了吼吼的精心安排，來一場美味的糖果雨，讓甜蜜在整個小鎮裡傳遞且讓吼吼的生活永遠不缺好玩的事。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇

programme.title: 極速悖論(完)
programme.desc: 【超越速度的愛情故事，不只想見柯佳嬿，合作《覆流年》翟子路，賽車場上大談13歲差姊弟戀！！】從小將賽車作為夢想的陳墨白，最大目標就是登上超級方程式賽場。碰上了貴為空氣動力學工程師的沈溪，卻隱身為辦公室的打雜小妹。彼此成為重要的陪伴，賽車場上超越速度也突破兩人心魔，共同為了夢想努力。

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君(完)
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 冒險心星球
programme.desc: 在遙遠的夢幻星球「蒙斯蘭迪斯」，每個地區都代表著一種心情，有充滿愛心的「愛之海」，有會噴火發脾氣的「憤怒火山」，當小精靈心情不好，就會被送到島上進行大冒險！

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君(完)
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL &amp; WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The rare earth
programme.desc: Along the way, Chip and his friends find an island surrounded by a large lake of acid, under the constant threat of eruption of a volcano. In the island lives lanthanide atoms, according to the legend, are awaiting the arrival of a "chosen" to give them acid that prevents them from leaving the island. Chip, thanks to his book, discovers that the volcano emitted a base when mixed with the acid may neutralize and make the dangerous lake in a nice extension of salt water.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The desert
programme.desc: Across a hot desert Chip and the atoms found themselves with a tungsten atom that gives them refuge under a pyramid-shaped building that, until recently, had an ingenious cooling system through which flowed a stream of ammonia in its basement. But now, Dr. No has diverted the flow of ammonia for his own benefit. Chip discovers the point where ammonia diverts and builds a dam that returns to its normal course.

programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Himalayan Heroes, Nepal
programme.desc: Hoping to follow in his great-aunt's footsteps, Glitch enlists the help of a sceptical Foz and a friendly yak in order to find a yeti in the Himalayas.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Work
programme.desc: In a game of 'Work', Dad hires Bluey and Bingo at his drainpipe factory. But when Bluey takes charge, Dad finds his new boss pretty tough, especially her no dancing rule.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Cafe
programme.desc: In the park, Bluey meets a new playmate named Winnie, but when Bluey wants to invite her and her dad home for breakfast, she learns that adults take a little bit longer to make friends.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - TV Shop
programme.desc: At the chemist, Bluey and Bingo have fun playing with the CCTV screens.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Slide
programme.desc: Bingo and Lila are excited to play on their new waterslide.

programme.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures (S1) - Andy and the Baby Alligators
programme.desc: When Andy inadvertently destroys an audio tape of a recording that Mr Hammond made of a baby alligator, it's up to him to replace it.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Snail
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Fortress of Fun, where Kingsley and Queenie have a snail slime race. But who will win, Team King or Team Queen?

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Treehouse Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning the clubhouse so the squirrels take refuge in the treehouse, but it's getting a little bit cramped these days. Norrie has an idea - maybe they need to add an extension.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Fossil Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are digging in the garden when they come across a fossil, so Duggee and Narrator explain all about fossils and prehistoric times.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Footprint Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are playing hide-and-seek, but they can't find Happy. The squirrels follow lots of different footprints that take them to their friend but there is one set they can't work out.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Christmas Island, Indian Ocean
programme.desc: The Go Jetters snap into action as Glitch seeks some festive cheer on Christmas Island.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Gua Rusa, Borneo
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch discovers his Halloween pumpkin isn't as big as the Grimbots' one, he goes in search of some fertilizer to help it grow.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S23) - Chucklesome Trucks
programme.desc: When Rebecca works with the Troublesome Trucks, everyone expects the worst, but she defies everyone's expectations and has a very amusing day.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Umbrella Bubbles
programme.desc: After getting muddy, Umbrella has to face his fear of getting wet and take his first bath.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Tortoise Snooze
programme.desc: When it is time for Tortoise to hibernate, Sarah and Duck help him find a quiet place.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Painting
programme.desc: Stanley goes to help Myrtle, who has found a paint smudge on the Town Hall's door!

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Circus
programme.desc: The circus bus has broken down, but the children are waiting for a circus show! Can Stanley help out?

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals (S1) - I'm An Actual Ninja You Know
programme.desc: From astronauts to acrobats, the animals talk about all the things they want to be when they grow up.

programme.desc: Cynthia has found a teddy lying on the ground - can JoJo and Gran Gran find its owner? JoJo discovers three clues - space, blue wool and a special label. Will they help JoJo and Gran Gran track down the owner of the lost teddy?

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Stories
programme.desc: Indy thinks she's no good because her model horse looks like a cow, but Calypso encourages her not to give up, so she tries to fix it with a little help from Winton.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Puppets
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Turtle Boy
programme.desc: Bingo finds a toy turtle at the playground and wants to take him home, but Dad says it's not the right thing to do.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Sleeping Badge
programme.desc: Tag is having trouble sleeping, so Duggee offers him a few tricks to help him.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Island Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are out doing a bit of sailing. What fun! When Tag starts to feel a little bit seasick Duggee suggests a stop off at the Island for a spot of lunch, but where's all the food?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Calm Down
programme.desc: Water, water, everywhere - there's a flood in our hospital soap opera! Grown-up Tag the firefighter splashes around. It's a good job grown-up Happy the lifeguard is on hand

programme.desc: Greedy Grandmaster Glitch has been gorging on chocolate and wants more! The Grimbots discover a place called the Chocolate Hills on Bohol Island in the Philippines and take him there.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Tablet Takeover
programme.desc: The Veggies are delighted with a new tablet they've found. When they're not looking, Evil Pea turns the tablet to evil mode. Soon the tablet takes over the supermarket.

programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Laa-Laa and Po pick delicious green beans. The Noo-­‐noo puts the beans into the Tubby Custard Machine and out comes tasty, green Tubby Custard!

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S3) - Digger
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'digger' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure! We see lots of diggers - a big digger, a small digger, a dumping digger and a really muddy digger!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S3) - Messy Gets Clean
programme.desc: Messy travels with Zoe and Felix to the Okido launderette and learns just how much soap is too much.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Pig Gets Big
programme.desc: Farmer Jackson was just trying to grow some giant tomatoes, but he wound up with a giant pig! Now, Mojo and Bo have to get Felix back to normal size before Swoppiton gets stomped.

programme.desc: Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny at a garage sale, making Dad push her on an old mobility scooter, but when a real Grouchy Granny wants to buy it, Muffin won't budge.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Tradies
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.

programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Laa-Laa and Po pick delicious green beans. The Noo-­‐noo puts the beans into the Tubby Custard Machine and out comes tasty, green Tubby Custard!

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family...

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time?

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: This tale of a honorable fighter's retraining in the "Iron Palm" style, that became the first international martial arts movie hit and made a continent-spanning star of Lo Lieh.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his father's death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiancee enlists a swordsman-who secretly loves her-to search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bat's knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit...

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancee before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancee before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her master's family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed "The Invincible Fist" is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother?

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: A young business man marries a pretty and much sought-after young bride, not knowing that she carries the spirit of a girl raped by her uncle and murdered along with her parents. Justice must be done, and it ain't pretty!

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the "Tsai Li Fu" style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yen's family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called "The Venoms", and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller; playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiance, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle...

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other's true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng's friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&amp;amp;B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and has to team up with his partner to recover the munitions so as to prevent a disaster from occurring.

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - In The Hall Of The Gumm-Gumm King
programme.desc: When Gunmar marches for Heartsone Trollmarket, the Trollhunting team must save the remaining Trolls and face Gunmar before all is lost

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Night Patroll
programme.desc: TheTrollhunters struggle to keep Trolls a secret in Arcadia.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Cunning Combat of the Covert Camoflush
programme.desc: The campers' splat-tastic game of paintball is rather rudely interrupted by a foul and formidable fiend known only as Camoflush.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Bad Beat of the Blah Borelock
programme.desc: With fun in short supply, Harold and George persuade Krupp to dump the campers in the middle of the forest so they can learn to rough it.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Ghastly Danger of the Ghost Dentist
programme.desc: The pressure's on Harold and George to tell the scariest campfire story ever. Perhaps their tale of an ill-fated frontier dentist will do the trick.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Born a Toretto
programme.desc: 17-year-old Tony Toretto and his gang are psyched when Dom recommends them to Ms. Nowhere for a spy racing job. Excited to get the opportunity to live up to Dom’s legacy, they use their street smarts and driving skills to infiltrate a race with SH1FT3R, a high-octane racing circuit whose drivers are all under 20.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Enter SH1FT3R
programme.desc: Tony goes head-to-head with SH1FT3R’s main recruiter Layla Gray in a death-defying spy race through LA Tunnels, parking lots and construction sites. Tony’s awesome driving impresses Shashi Dhar (the head of SH1FT3R and the person Ms. Nowhere wants them to investigate), and after Tony and his crew pull a heist on a big rig full of energy drinks for Shashi, they’re officially accepted into the circuit.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Ghost Town Grand Prix
programme.desc: Tony races against Shashi and Layla through a Northern California ghost town, but Shashi and Layla are using the race as a cover for a heist on a billionaire’s train. Tony and his team are introduced to the other cool SH1FT3R racers, and while they can’t stop the heist without blowing their cover, they do manage to get a tracker on the train car Shashi and Layla stole.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Owl Job
programme.desc: Shashi sends Tony and Layla to steal weapons codes from a Russian oligarch, while Margaret "Echo" Pearl, Cisco and Frostee use Shashi’s absence to sneak into Shashi’s Cliffside mansion to investigate. Ms. Nowhere tells the team to look for the "keys" in Shashi’s mansion, but all they find are a couple of awesome super-cars.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Celestial Vault
programme.desc: Shashi stages a race up the privately-owned Mount Zebulon, and he invites Tony, Cisco, and Margaret "Echo" Pearl to participate. The crew soon discovers that Shashi is using the race to steal another super-car (this time from space!) - and he knows that Tony is working with the feds.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Warthog Is Ugly
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Warthog was really rather handsome. And did he know it! He strutted around Tinga Tinga as if he owned the place. All the animals were fed up with Warthog's boasting, and then one day Lion decided to give chase. Yikes! Warthog ran headfirst into Porcupines burrow! After that, he was no longer the prettiest beast in Tinga Tinga. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Owls Head Turns All The Way Round
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Owl's head didn't turn all the way round. She had tiny little eyes and tiny little ears, and she found it very hard to stay awake. Then one day all the Mangoes started disappearing in Tinga Tinga. Against all the animals better judgement, Owl was ordered to watch over the Mango tree … but the mangoes kept disappearing.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Heavy Loader
programme.desc: Roary takes Loada on a jaunt to the beach… only to discover that sand and lorries don't mix too well!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Testing Time For Maxi
programme.desc: PC Pete and Nick are up at Silver hatch giving the cars their road tests. Is Maxi really going to be as good as he says he is or will he be unpleasantly surprised?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Mum's The Word
programme.desc: Christine (Big Chris' mum) is visiting Silver hatch. As is Mamma Mia… serious competition ensues!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - How The Hatch Was Won
programme.desc: Tin Top is feeling homesick so Big Chris tries to cheer him up. But who could that pesky varmint causing trouble on the track be?!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Go Gadget James And Maxi
programme.desc: Maxi is jealous of all of James' gadgets, or more precisely, the attention the other cars give him. He persuades Molecom to devise some gadgets for him… with hilarious results

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Mr Carburettor Or Bust
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor has commissioned a bust of himself for Silver Hatch. Disaster strikes when it is dropped, Big Chris tries to make amends, while Marsha distracts Mr Carburettor and the reporter

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Spinny Water Kelp's Song
programme.desc: Kelp and his underwater friends race around an obstacle course, but Cruz gets sucked into a whirlpool. As each of them try to rescue him, they are sucked in! Kelp saves them all using his unicorn spark to create bubbles he attaches to seaweed. Kelp helps his unicorn friends create music with their horns and pieces of nature. Ollie is embarrassed by the sound of his horn.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Heavy Metal
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders get stuck in a cave with their rival, Magnus, during a race to find a new source of an important mineral.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - That's Sooo Rob
programme.desc: Julien’s former BFF, Rob, returns to lure the king away from his royal responsibilities and back to his crazy partying days.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - The Man In The Iron Booty
programme.desc: King Julien sends his entire kingdom away on rafts to help an alleged fellow king who is supposedly in distress.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Cunning Combat of the Covert Camoflush
programme.desc: The campers' splat-tastic game of paintball is rather rudely interrupted by a foul and formidable fiend known only as Camoflush.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Bad Beat of the Blah Borelock
programme.desc: With fun in short supply, Harold and George persuade Krupp to dump the campers in the middle of the forest so they can learn to rough it.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Empty Well
programme.desc: The kids are low on supplies in the Sahara and stumble on a town with a well that has mysteriously run dry. The crew decides to investigate and discovers a Cleve Kelso-controlled water facility that’s stealing water from the village. They manage to blow up the facility, but it alerts Rafaela and Matsuo to their whereabouts.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Hunt
programme.desc: In an awesome chasebattle through the desert, the crew goes up against Rafaela, Matsuo, and Sandocal - who are driving the kids’ own cars. The crew struggles to fight back while also not losing the trail to Cleve’s base in the desert. When Rafaela turns on Sandocal, he and Layla decide to work together and manage to overpower Rafaela and Matsuo. Sandocal tells the kids to go to escape toward the Bedouin Shield.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Tag Team Cattitude Adjustment
programme.desc: With a new family moving to town, Mayor Sniffington wants Pawston to look perfect. Tag and Scooch offer to help, but it's too many chores to do on their own, so Tag builds a robot to help. But when Frank and Beans catch wind of the robot, they try to swipe it so that it will do their personal chores. \ When Tag learns that Pawston's new fire chief is a cat, she leads a welcoming effort with the dogs of Pawston.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Hocus Pocus Furricane
programme.desc: When Tag and Scooch get a once-in-a-lifetime chance to learn magic from Muttfield, Tag cannot wait to be the star of the end-of-class show. When Scooch outshines Tag with his natural gift for magic, Tag gets jealous and attempts a master level trick that goes awry. \ The dogs are shedding their winter coats and it's the day of the big Pawston Picnic.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Missing Marcus The Baby-Glitter’s Club

programme.desc: Lerk and Thunk hide all the valley's worms in a cave to protect them from the hunters who want to use them as bait; Grug invents the spear and pitches it to the Valley as a tool that will change cavemanity forever!
